title: The Group Chat of the water tower
author: Wendell Reyes
blurb: Felix Almeida, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
